title: Pauli Contextuality Lab: Unified Lean 4.35.0 Formalization of Spectral Bounds, Disjoint Mermin Configurations, and Sequential Contextuality Evidence
peer_review_status: Consolidated research preprint suite (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 & cross-platform CI verified)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue

lean_verification.framework: Lean 4.35.0 / Mathlib v4.35.0 (166 explicit #print axioms including HoggarBound.Stability + 2,206-theorem-constant Lean.collectAxioms audit over the 43 modules imported by VerifyAll.lean (1,175 authored theorem/lemma declarations across all 60 files); 0 Batteries linter errors across 10 modules (HoggarBound.{Moment,Pauli,Bound,Counting,Corollaries,Quadric,Kramers,Stability}, ContextualityTensor, Evidence); 12 headline targets verified across 6 independent kernels via lake comparator --paranoid in Ubuntu CI run 45939143168, Sigstore Rekor logIndex 4141656897)

core_result: Consolidates the four archived Pauli/Mermin contextuality repositories (hoggar-bound, hoggar-bound-lab, contextuality-tensor-lab, contextuality-evidence-lab) into one unified Apache-2.0 / CC-BY-4.0 monorepo meeting Build Standard v1.2.0 (100.0%, 68/68 checks, Core 30/30, 10 finding classes, Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema-validated repo.yaml) and Defensible Independent AI Research Playbook v1.3 (ERRATA.md, CRediT & COI disclosures across all 4 manuscripts, 1,900-problem Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas V2 cross-reference in docs/mega-atlas-cross-reference.md recording 0/1,900 grand problems solved; the results are thematically related to QM-011 (the atlas entry was not checked to list them as sub-cases), BibTeX + Handle + Crossref retraction-free citation audit across 44/44 URLs and 17/17 journal DOIs, 3 negative Lean sanity checks on closed decidable facts, repo-wide CDN sha384 SRI guard, GFM table column-count regression guard, OSF Preprints DOI fallback, and SHA-256-verified gitleaks v8.30.1 + osv-scanner v2.7.1 CI). Ships a single pinned Lean 4.35.0 + Mathlib v4.35.0 workspace (transparent 60-module audit map in lean/README.md; partial Palomar module headers 5/60 files honestly disclosed), deduplicated third-party stack, searchable 27-node / 162-declaration Lean Blueprint (/blueprint/) with MathJax SRI, explicit Sp(2N,2) witness isomorphism verifier plus Qontextium-ready hyperbolic quasi-quadric (135/1,095/75) exports (/exports/hyperbolic-quasi-quadric-135/), 4 zero-overflow Tectonic PDFs (literal 0.00pt max overfull hbox across all 4 PDFs; all 8 2026-11-26 statement-audit manuscript/doc/log errata resolved in place), and 3-OS + 14-engine zero-warning C11 ASan/UBSan CI (run 45939143081). Track 1 formalizes Jonah's universal spectral floor and Kramers floor (prior work, here for arbitrary supports) and proves 5-way saturation equivalences, an infinite non-closed pure-CCZ family |Psi_{3m}> attaining the floor (degree 2016 at m = 2; contextual for m >= 2), lower bounds d(W(7,2))>=1455 and d(Q+(9,2))>=6444 (below the exact values 1575 and 6975 claimed earlier by Jonah), exact four-qubit C3 binary completion optima (368 vs 344) for one sign pair, and strict-law failure for one explicit representative of each of the 9 vertex cases of Jonah's Conjecture E for every N>=4 (case coverage via Jonah's Theorem B4, outside Lean). The finite degrees 75, 480 and 729344 are in modules not compiled at the pinned commit. Track 2 proves exact arbitrary-k disjoint-copy formulas d_k=(7^k-5^k)/2 (squares) and (6^k-4^k)/2 (pentagrams) addressing Muller & Saniga (arXiv:2609.19862v1 Sec. 6; unreviewed preprint) for these two families (with Cabello arXiv:1002.3135 and Sec. 4.2 credited). Track 3 proves finite adaptive-tree sequential evidence bounds and a sharp setting-bias attack on the Peres-Mermin square. Live Ubuntu CI run 45939143168 audited 166 explicit #print axioms (including HoggarBound.Stability) and all 2,206 kernel theorem constants strictly within standard axioms, ran Batteries runLinter with 0 errors across 10 modules, passed 3 negative Lean sanity checks, and verified all 12 cross-track comparator targets across all 6 independent kernels (lean-paranoid, lean4lean, nanoda, con-leche, con-ron, lean-default) with Sigstore/Rekor attestation (Lean logIndex 4141656897; Release v3.1.0 run 45941634786 Rekor logIndex 4141681890; DigiCert RFC 3161 TSA + 3-calendar OpenTimestamps verified via OpenSSL X.509 in CI).
verification_boundary: 166 explicit headline declarations (including all 6 HoggarBound.Stability theorems) plus an exhaustive 2,206-theorem-constant Lean.collectAxioms audit in VerifyAll.lean (zero sorry, zero native_decide, no Lean elaboration warnings besides Lake module-system import notices, strictly within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]), 0 Batteries linter errors across 10 modules, 3 negative Lean sanity checks on closed decidable facts (the masked 300s leanchecker --fresh timeout was removed in v3.1.0), and the 12 cross-track Challenge/Solution targets are additionally re-checked by 6 independent kernels; the Saturated*, C3Certificate, C3Spectra, C3Theorem, FlatData and PhaseData modules are not compiled in that CI run; 52 pytest suites (including DigiCert RFC 3161 TSA + OpenTimestamps + SWHID + submission-packet + GFM table column-count checks) (+6 subtests, including repo-wide CDN sha384 SRI guard, Draft 2020-12 repo.yaml schema, 10-class labels, _native.* axiom-rejection & Palomar size guards, Sp(2N,2) witness isomorphism & Qontextium export tests, property, negative, 6-mutant killing, 300-payload fuzz, live C3/Blueprint/explorer/monorepo integrity), 2 Node web-model tests, 7 track exact verifiers, and 14 zero-warning C11 ASan/UBSan engines pass across Linux/macOS/Windows CI. Finite C censuses (540.3M N=9 forms, 42-orbit W(5,2) census), Moonlab/QGTL/QRNG simulations, and exploratory floating-point scripts are explicitly separated from Lean kernel proofs (see CLAIMS.md, LIMITATIONS.md, ERRATA.md, and docs/statement-fidelity.md). No external peer review, hardware experiment, or external DOI is claimed. data/MANIFEST.sha256 is cryptographically timestamped by DigiCert RFC 3161 TSA (.tsr, OpenSSL X.509 Verification: OK in CI) and 3-calendar Bitcoin OpenTimestamps (.ots), and an author-automated Python/Node clean-clone check passed on v2.9.0 (17.7s, no Lean step; external human replication remains open).
